title: Wealdstone Emergency Help Points
summary: Key hospitals, urgent treatment centres, hazards, and supplies for Wealdstone.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always call 999 or 112 first.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- Northwick Park Hospital: Watford Road, Harrow HA1 3UJ. From Harrow & Wealdstone station: ~25 min walk south along High Street, Station Road, and Watford Road (~1.3 miles), or take bus 182, 186, or 258 directly towards the hospital grounds.
- Nearest Major Trauma Centre: St Mary's Hospital, Praed Street, London W2 1NY (~9 miles southeast; access via Southern or Bakerloo rail lines from Harrow & Wealdstone towards central London).

2. Urgent Treatment Centres (UTC):
- Alexandra Avenue Health and Social Care Centre: 275 Alexandra Avenue, South Harrow HA2 9DX. From Harrow & Wealdstone station: ~2 miles south; take bus 140 or Bakerloo/Overground to Harrow-on-the-Hill, then bus 114 to Alexandra Avenue.
- Northwick Park Urgent Treatment Centre: Co-located with the main A&E at Watford Road, Harrow HA1 3UJ (open 24/7 for urgent non-life-threatening care).

3. Local Hazard Notes:
- Wealdstone Brook runs through the district; heavy sustained rainfall creates localized flash flood risks along low-lying sections of High Street, Byron Park, and surrounding railway underpasses.
- Major transport junctions near Harrow & Wealdstone station experience severe surface pooling during storm surges.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
Pharmacies and larger supermarkets along High Street Wealdstone and Station Road can supply bottled water, first-aid items, and essential medicines during outages.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
